summary: Lock bikes with repeated fault reports sooner
description: Mechanics have flagged a few bikes that kept getting ridden with an obviously bent wheel or a slipping brake, well after riders had already reported the same fault more than once. They'd like the fault threshold tightened so a repeatedly-reported bike gets pulled sooner, before it does someone an injury out on the road.

comments.author: ren.okafor
comments.body: What threshold are we thinking -- how much sooner than today?

comments.author: priya.lund
comments.body: Worth being careful here -- tighten it too far and we'll start locking bikes over one grumpy rider's duplicate report.

comments.author: tobin.achebe
comments.body: Talked this through with mechanics and landed on 2 fault reports inside a 7-day window before a bike gets locked. Leaving this open until it actually ships.
